title: Double Dolly
description: A double dolly shot moves performer and camera together on one rolling platform so their relative arrangement stays fixed. The actor appears to glide rather than walk: feet skating, weight transfer absent.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: An interior state made external. Fate, dread, or transcendence carries the person through a hallway while the world slides.

It differs from a stabilized walk because normal stepping is missing on purpose. It is the wrong tool if the performer walks normally, and the wrong tool if only the camera dollies toward a planted actor.
Both must share the ride.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Conceal a platform (or a virtual equivalent) that carries actor and camera. Coordinate speed so background parallax is the only travel.
For generation, keep the feet still and the body upright while the environment passes. Prompt a double dolly: subject and camera share one rolling platform, figure gliding, feet skating.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when an interior state should be made external: the person is carried by an idea. Concrete beat: an armed figure glides down a hallway, feet not walking.
Do not use it as a fancy walk-and-talk.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: A Dolly In moves only the camera. Steadicam lets both walk, with normal gait.
Double dolly freezes the relationship and removes the walk. If the feet cycle, the float is gone.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Do the Right Thing is the float's home grammar. Malcolm X stylizes approach toward the assassination sequence.
BlacKkKlansman ends on an armed glide through a hallway. Inside Man uses a floating reaction after the apparent hostage killing.
Feet still, world passing: that is the tell.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Double dolly on [Subject]: subject and camera share one rolling platform so the figure appears to glide, feet skating, Spike Lee floating grammar. For motion: [Subject] and the camera move together on the same dolly, creating a floating glide through the space.

A detective stands completely still, feet planted, while she and the camera glide forward together down a long corridor. Her face stays the same size and position. Background moves smoothly backward. No walking cycle, no bobbing, no flying pose, solemn inevitability.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Steadicam walk or a solo Dolly In. The tell is a normal gait, or a planted actor growing in frame.
The fix: shared platform, feet not stepping, environment streaming, body upright.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Double Dolly in film?
It is a shot where actor and camera ride the same moving platform, so the person glides and the world slides while their size in frame stays oddly constant.
Double Dolly vs Steadicam
Steadicam follows a walking person. Double dolly carries both, suppressing the walk so the figure floats.
When should I use Double Dolly?
When a mental state should carry a body through space. Do not use it for ordinary corridor dialogue.
How do I prompt Double Dolly for AI image or video?
Write subject and camera on the same dolly, figure gliding, feet still, environment passing. Ban a normal walk.
